newsitem.title: UK: Rank Group to create 3,000 jobs in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Rank Group to create 3,000 jobs in 1997.

text.p: The Rank Group Plc, Britain's biggest leisure group, said on Thursday it would create 3,000 full-time jobs in the UK this year.
The jobs will be in new bingo clubs, pub-restaurants, night clubs, holiday facilities and a new multi-leisure centre.
Some 750 jobs will be generated as 10 new Mecca bingo clubs are established around the country. The first is in the Midlands town of Chestefield and opens today (Thursday).
Two bingo clubs will open for business on Merseyside, a further two in Birmingham, two in Scotland plus others in Staffordshire, Leicester and Sheffield.
More than 700 full-time jobs are being created in north west England as Rank unit Oasis Forest Holiday Villages develops a site in Cumbria.
